name: team_planning_set_unit
description: Create, rename or move a unit in a scenario of a Team Planning plan. Without unit_id it creates a unit, which needs a name and a level_id from the Org Graph taxonomy. With unit_id (an Org Graph unit, or one the plan created) it changes that unit: whatever you leave out stays as the scenario has it, and a retired unit comes back. parent_id places it beneath a live unit at a higher level; top_level true puts it at the top. A unit's level can't change. scenario_id defaults to the baseline, whose id is the plan's. Refused unless the caller is one of the plan's editors.

name.description: What the unit is, such as 'Payments'. Don't put a person's name in it.
